eas_text: A civil authority has issued AN IMMEDIATE EVACUATION NOTICE for the following counties or areas: Millard, UT; at 4:50 AM on AUG 2, 2026 Effective until 4:50 AM AUG 3, 2026. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: Millard/Sheriff: 5:40 am Mandatory evacuation for 4400 S to Reservation Rd Meadow Life-threatening, fast-changing conditions. Leave now and avoid the area. Leave immediately by the designated route. Take only what you have already prepared by the door. Do not stop to gather additional belongings. Help neighbors leave if it is safe to do so. Keep listening to local news and cell phone alerts. Shelter: Fillmore armory 45 W Center. If you cannot leave, call 911.
